content.text: economic (ɛkənɒmɪk , ik- ) 1. adjective Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society. ...Poland's radical economic reforms. economically (ɛkənɒmɪkli , ik- ) adverb ...an economically depressed area. 2. adjective If something is economic, it produces a profit. Critics say that the new system may be more economic but will lead to a decline in program quality. Collins COBUILD Advanced Learner’s Dictionary.
